name: Compania General de Electricidad S.A.
summary: Compañía General de Electricidad S.A., engages in the distribution of electricity in Chile. The company provides various services, such as corrective maintenance, leasing of electrical installations and measurement equipment, postal dispatch, support poles, project elaboration, air and underground distribution networks, aerial and underground street lighting, LED lighting, diagnosis and maintenance, and solar panels. Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. was founded in 1905 and is based in Santiago, Chile. Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. is a subsidiary of Naturgy Energy Group, S.A.
